outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative pseudocoloured photoactivation image sequences for three proteins without any quantification or statistics, so replicate reporting is not required.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
outputs.explanation: Panel B presents quantified fluorescence-recovery/relaxation curves fitted with a diffusion model, which requires replicate reporting, but the caption only refers to 'the experiment displayed in (A)' without stating how many cells, regions, or independent experiments were measured or averaged, and does not specify the replicate type (biological vs technical).
